verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs say traces can be captured through its native SDKs for Python and JS, and list SDK-based API access from Python or JS/TS. A community user who has run Langfuse for about 6 months independently confirms that official SDKs exist for Python and TypeScript. missing for 10: in-depth first-party SDK instrumentation docs (instrumentation APIs, auto-instrumentation details), hands-on corroboration of JS/TS instrumentation specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs
